## SECTION 12 — FINAL EXECUTION OPINION (Valuation + Verdict)

### 12.1 Valuation engine selection (Step 0-3)

**Selected engine: Two-stage FCFF DCF, using weighted-average cost of capital (WACC) discounting, mid-year-adjusted end-period discounting (T0 = 2026-08-24).**

Why FCFF-DCF: Ross is an unlevered-ish, net-cash company with no preferred stock and a simple capital structure; FCFF isolates operating value, to which I add net cash. Cross-checks: (1) normalized-earnings multiple; (2) reverse DCF (what the price embeds); (3) updated trailing P/E vs. history.

Working-capital definition used: ΔNWC ≈ 0.1% of sales per year (pack's own ΔWC arithmetic shows −$0.064B in FY2026, i.e., ~zero; retail inventory/AP cycles roughly self-fund at scale). SBC is NOT added back — it stays as an expense inside EBIT, matching the pack's explicit warning. Operating leases are excluded from net debt and remain inside EBIT expense.
